_comment: Single source of truth for constants used by BOTH the Kale backend and the JupyterLab frontend. The backend reads this file through kale/shared_constants.py; the frontend imports it through labextension/src/lib/sharedConstants.ts. Change a value here only - never in a language-specific copy.

error_explanations.IMPORT_ERROR: Kale could not import a Python module it needs. The Kale backend may be missing from the kernel this notebook is running on.
error_explanations.ENCODING_ERROR: Kale could not decode the data exchanged with the notebook kernel.
error_explanations.NOT_FOUND: Kale could not find what it was looking for. It may have been renamed or deleted.
error_explanations.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong inside Kale while handling this request.
error_explanations.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: Kale cannot reach a service it needs, such as the Kubeflow Pipelines API server. You can keep editing and compiling notebooks, but uploading and running pipelines will not work until it is reachable again.
error_explanations.UNHANDLED_ERROR: Kale hit an unexpected error and could not complete this request.
